decisions.reason: Gives paste_image/paste_file names with smallest-N (2)+ suffix before extension, reserves names within the batch and against live attachments, scopes renaming to the paste path via a source flag on add() while drop/picker keep real names.

Names live composer snapshot occurrences via getSnapshot() as authoritative, quotes the subscription showing records.delete fires on any momentary empty snapshot while the attachment remains live, and adds each batch-assigned name to the working set.

Uses the captured response (x-cache HIT, age 178, stale v0.2.9) and renderCurrentChip(tag) to explain the stale label, and gives the semantic rule remote > local shows update, remote <= local shows running PLUGIN_VERSION, never the older fetched tag.

Proposes repeated and same-batch pastes with expected names, a test where the records entry is retired but the live occurrence still forces (2), drop/picker names unchanged, and older and genuinely newer remote tag chip tests.

Covers syncing package.json with the hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION and node --check plus regressions, but deployment is under-explained: it says users re-fetch on hard refresh and that the chip is notification-only, without explaining updating/deploying the served artifact itself before the reload.
